rules.statement: Under section 170 of the Land Development Ordinance, no written law other than this Ordinance which provides for succession to land upon an intestacy shall have any application in respect of any land alienated under the Land Development Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: Under section 170 of the Land Development Ordinance no written law other than this Ordinance which provides for succession to land upon an intestacy (and no other law relating to succession to land upon an intestacy) shall have any application in respect of any land alienated under the Land Development Ordinance.
